source_transform: Canonical Panels exports use internal seam bodies of approximately 1/24 of the visible symbol's maximum extent, with the approved panel ends retained. See the canonical guide and manifest for the parent export transform.
composition: Canonical horizontal symbol-plus-name PNGs copied byte-for-byte. The exporter tight-trims alpha and scales uniformly to 36 pixels of content height. White parent artwork accompanies both white and mint Wheelhouse; the parent artwork is never recolored.
